success.narration: You repeat the flattened note. The square winces, but Room Seven answers with the correct pitch—once, sharply—from behind its closed shutter. A second figure across the square starts toward the boarding house, realizes you saw them, and turns away.

payload.what: When Mira deliberately played the shared tune wrong, the supposedly empty Room Seven answered with the correct final note.

nearMiss.narration: The wrong note draws a dozen unconscious corrections at once. You cannot isolate the first voice, but every correcting face turns toward the boarding house before its owner remembers not to. The trap reveals a shared direction, not a culprit.

fail.narration: The bent note sets the belfry tag rattling and the clapper answers too loudly. Irritated faces turn toward you, then away. Whatever listened from upstairs stays silent; the performer has time to move while the square blames the bard.
